title: Building a heroic fantasy RPG like game with Claude
author: dam_ballah

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/dam_ballah could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: dam_ballah
replies.body: Great question , musical themes were recorded “minimistically” on a acoustic piano then fed to CC for musical arrangements, sketches images were similarly drawn and fed to CC for screen structure , Comfy was used for art assets on a very conservative PHP/mysql tech stack
